AxTableField.Name: HSMobileOpsDualCount
AxTableField.HelpText: Lines on this journal are settled by the dual count rules: a line needing two independent counts gets two, any other settles at its first. It can only post once every line is resolved.
AxTableField.Label: Dual count

AxTableField.Name: HSMobileOpsWallToWall
AxTableField.HelpText: A wall-to-wall count: counted by location task, and it can only post once every line is settled and every location is complete. Its warehouse is frozen until then.
AxTableField.Label: Wall-to-wall
